scope: Refresh current LibreCAD and LibreCAD_3 downstream compatibility evidence and screen a newly surfaced 2D IR pipeline without promoting it to an independent DWG/3D oracle.

method.kind: Read-only immutable local git refs plus current primary project and package documentation
method.workingTreeCaveat: Both sibling working trees contain unrelated local changes or are behind origin/master; only committed origin/master objects were inspected.
method.evidenceBoundary: Source-level callback and policy observations only. No LibreCAD UI behavior, native consumer acceptance, parser correctness, DWG write support, or 3D geometry semantics were exercised. Mutable default branches and package/source version claims are not runtime identity.

observed: RS_FilterDXFRW::addModelerGeometry stores DRW_ModelerGeometry in advanced metadata as an opaque sidecar.
If the SAB wireframe decoder yields edges, the adapter creates XY-derived 2D entities and sets their source handle to zero.
The adapter path is an optional 2D display projection plus source-data retention; it does not construct an editable 3D solid or verify B-rep semantics.
findings.planUse: Maintain existing callback/API compatibility and distinguish opaque carrier replay from derived XY display entities. No new native 3D qualification task.

observed: A source-symbol search in persistence/libdxfrw found no DRW_ModelerGeometry, ACIS, 3DSOLID, REGION, or BODY callback integration.
The current DWG support policy makes import opt-in and read-only, declares DWG writing unimplemented/not planned, and reports 15 pinned read claims: 11 EXPERIMENTAL, 4 PENDING_NATIVE, zero PROMOTED.

any qualified DWG write or 3D consumer support
findings.planUse: Treat LibreCAD_3 as a 2D source/API compatibility target, not a 3D consumer or independent parser vote.

observed: The project describes a typed 2D CAD IR with source identity and import/export diagnostics.
Its DWG adapter uses ezdwg, so it shares the already reviewed DWG parser lineage.
Its declared 2D data model and conversion path do not decode or preserve ACIS 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY semantics; explicit SOLID/TRACE/3DFACE handling is not an ACIS solid route.
R12 downgrade diagnostics and entity disposition may be a low-cost optional 2D projection check if the exact package and dependency lock are pinned.
findings.planUse: DISCOVERY_ONLY / 2D_IR_CONSUMER. No independent DWG vote, 3D evidence, repository dependency, or per-slice validation.
